title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a solid 1982 performance with clear audio and strong playing.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this version as the best‑sounding source available, noting crisp, clean audio that benefits from a good‑sounding venue. The show itself is described as "quite good," making it an enjoyable listen despite the lack of specific song highlights. Overall the recording delivers high fidelity and a satisfying performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 4‑star reviews highlight both excellent audio quality and a strong musical performance, giving the recording an overall rating in the high‑mid range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with venue acoustics enhancing the sound; reviewers call it the best‑sounding of all available sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; overall performance described as solid and enjoyable.
